profiles.rail_profile.csv: rail head surface height z (mm, upward) versus lateral coordinate y (mm)
profiles.wheel_profile.csv: wheel tread surface height z (mm, upward) versus the same lateral coordinate y (mm), in the measured relative position, at the wheel's lowest point (the section through the wheel axis)
profiles.frame: both profiles are in one track-fixed frame; the undeformed vertical separation at lateral position y is wheel z minus rail z, up to a constant (the bodies are pressed together by the normal load); contact is close to horizontal, so treat it as planar

kinematics.rolling_direction: the wheel rolls in +x; material passes through the contact from +x (leading edge) to -x (trailing edge)
kinematics.creepages: xi (longitudinal) and eta (lateral) are dimensionless rigid slip velocities of the wheel relative to the rail divided by the rolling speed; phi is the spin creepage (rad/m). Rigid slip of a wheel point at (x, y) relative to the rail: (xi - phi*y, eta + phi*x)
kinematics.forces: Fx, Fy: total tangential force exerted BY THE RAIL ON THE WHEEL, in N, positive in +x / +y
